description: This file defines the VueControllerHelper class in the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Helper. It provides methods to prepare context data for rendering Vue.js components within the OrangeHRM HRM system, including user info, menu items, theme data, and permissions. The class uses various traits and services to gather data for frontend components.

classes.name: VueControllerHelper
classes.description: Helper class to generate context parameters for Vue.js components in OrangeHRM, aggregating user, menu, theme, and permission data.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Gathers and returns all context parameters needed for rendering the Vue component, including user info, menu items, theme, and breadcrumb.

methods.name: getAssetsVersion
methods.description: Returns the timestamp/version of the Vue assets.

methods.name: getUserObject
methods.description: Returns basic information about the logged-in user, including name, profile image URL, and password status.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Fetches top and side menu items for the current request base URL.

methods.name: getContextItems
methods.description: Retrieves current screen/context title and icon.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the ScreenPermissionService instance.

methods.name: getBreadcrumb
methods.description: Constructs breadcrumb navigation data based on current module and screen.

methods.name: getHelpUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the help page specific to the current module and screen.
